rows.excerpt: Directors’ Report DONATION The donations made by the Group in the year were RMB5,124 million. FINANCIAL SUMMARY A summary of the condensed consolidated results and financial positions of the Group is set out on page 3 of this annual report. PURCHASE, SALE OR REDEMPTION OF THE COMPANY’S LISTED SECURITIES During the year ended 31 December 2022, the Company repurchased a total of 107,083,000 Shares on the Stock Exchange for an aggregate consideration of approximately HKD33.8 billion before expenses. The repurchased Shares were subsequently cancelled. The repurchase was effected for the enhancement of shareholder value in the long term.
